name: Exato Technologies Ltd
tagline: Rs ~715 Cr NSE-SME customer-experience / CXaaS + 'AI-as-a-Service' IT-services company -- Q1-FY27 revenue +50% YoY, PAT +104%, ~Rs 660 Cr order book, promoter ~55% -- guiding 50-60% FY27 growth, but ~38x earnings / ~8x book on an unproven AI-services narrative
business_overview: Exato Technologies (NSE SME: 544626) provides CX-as-a-Service (CXaaS), AI-as-a-Service, automation, unified communications and analytics to 150+ enterprise clients, positioning itself as a 'customer transformation partner' and pushing packaged, AI-layered solutions and its 'Exato IQ' platform, with a stated shift toward international expansion.
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 660 Cr (up ~Rs 60 Cr on new international deals)
fundamentals_narrative: Momentum is real -- Q1-FY27 revenue up 50% and PAT up 104%, an order book of ~Rs 660 Cr against ~Rs 180 Cr trailing revenue, and management guiding 50-60% FY27 growth. But this is a small IT-services / CX-tech company in a crowded, offshore-competitive space; the 'AI-as-a-Service' and 'Exato IQ platform' framing is a narrative layer whose revenue quality and durability are unproven, and the stock already trades at ~38x earnings and ~8x book, pricing the guided growth. One strong listed quarter is not a track record.

verdict_headline: Fast-growing SME CX-tech with a big order book but an unproven AI-services narrative at ~38x -- 'neither', conviction Low-Medium
verdict_reasoning: Loose relevance to the priority-2 'US + Indian software / product-SaaS turn' theme, but this is CX / IT services rather than product SaaS, and it was processed as an external lead, not a discovery theme hit.

four_box score 2.0 -> 'neither'. tailwind weak (enterprise AI / CX-automation spend is real but Exato is a small integrator, not a platform owner), tam weak (crowded CX / IT-services niche, ~Rs 715 Cr mcap), moat weak (150 clients give some stickiness; 'Exato IQ' unproven), valuation weak (~38x earnings, ~8x book -- guided growth priced in). Score 2.0 is at the exception threshold and the Q1-FY27 growth (+50% revenue / +104% PAT) is strong, but one listed quarter from an untrusted SME lead is not the 'un-ignorable growth' carve-out, so the label stays 'neither'.

Conviction Low-Medium: raised a notch above Low by the order book and growth rate; capped by valuation, one-quarter track record, narrative-driven revenue-quality risk and the untrusted source. Re-check after two-plus listed quarters confirm the guidance and the order book converts at stable margins.
